ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio (approx 0.15:0.85); surface is predominantly low-intensity black/dark grey with isolated high-intensity white clusters at tips and linear scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark base pigmentation across both lobes. Focal high-contrast white blobs at extreme distal tips. Scattered fine white mottling concentrated along the lower center-to-right regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approx. 65-degree sharp V-shaped depression; depth is approx. 20% of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration; left lobe trailing edge displays moderate frequency low-amplitude peaks; right lobe trailing edge displays a deep, high-amplitude jagged indentation approx. one-third from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outward sweep on both lobes, terminating in pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of circular white high-intensity pixels at the distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct white linear marks on the right lobe: one primary vertical-diagonal scar in the mid-lower quadrant and a smaller horizontal mark in the upper-mid quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white linear scars on the right lobe; heavy white barnacle colonization on distal lobe tips; jagged trailing edge with distinct missing tissue segments on the right lobe.
